decisions: This repair supersedes the prior route/generation fence only for opaque status of an already admitted request in its same registered account/pane. Capture/new work admission remains frozen to original source/owner/generation; unrelated media lines and cross-account UI never inherit that job.
Add bounded native acceptance/progress/terminal receipts and a closed UUID-only status query; keep active jobs from eviction and stale/cross-account replies from affecting current jobs.

A definitive absent receipt must also prevent a delayed original request with that identity from starting after the UI releases it. Bound retained state and reject capacity rather than guessing or erasing live jobs.
Rejected valid same-pane submissions receive a terminal failure without bypassing readiness/capture validation. Malformed/foreign messages remain rejected.

Poll only status while a visible document has unresolved jobs; recover lost acknowledgement/result from native state. Missing transport fails before submission; no-response remains explicit status-unknown rather than asserted downloading.

Separate persistent same-account pane notice from exact media-element progress. Route change/recycled media removes only stale inline bars; hidden/private panes expose no status UI until safely shown again.
Fixed-category admission/outcome diagnostics must not contain source text, URLs, credentials or private page data.
Publish terminal counters, worker outcome and its explanatory message as one terminal receipt. An intermediate terminal counter alone must not release ownership or claim the final outcome.

If an exact cancellation remains unconfirmed and native status still says active, offer an explicit user cancellation retry. Never automatically retry the save or infer cancellation from transport silence.
